title: AI and Synthetic Data in Low-Resource Settings
summary: A masterclass teaching materials repository with two Jupyter notebooks demonstrating synthetic text and tabular data generation for low-resource settings, including a Ghanaian household-survey use case. Its tabular notebook only suggests SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as an optional extension exercise for readers to try, not something the notebook itself runs.
evidence: "- **SDV**: `pip install sdv` and try `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` — compare its fidelity to both routes here.\n"
needs: Confirm SDV is never actually executed elsewhere in the notebook; evidence shows only a suggested exercise.
